readout_other: Confocal imaging of CoroNa Green AM (Na+ indicator), Oregon Green 488 BAPTA-1 AM (Ca2+ indicator), and synaptopHluorin (vesicle exocytosis reporter); whole-cell current-clamp recordings of CA1 pyramidal neurons
direction_notes: LILFU triggered voltage-gated Na+ transients, action potentials, voltage-dependent Ca2+ transients (somatic and presynaptic), and SNARE-mediated synaptic vesicle exocytosis/synaptic transmission in hippocampal CA1 neurons; effects were blocked by TTX (Na+ channel blocker), reduced by Cd2+ (Ca2+ channel blocker), reduced ~50% by CNQX+APV (glutamate receptor blockers), and nearly abolished by BoNT/A (SNARE cleavage).
safety_notes: No cavitation was observed during LILFU stimulation by optical microscopy. Chronic stimulation with LILFU-1 every 8 min for 36-48 h did not alter the fine membrane structure (dendritic spines) of YFP+ CA1 pyramidal neurons compared to unstimulated controls (n=9 slices each).

exposures.label: LILFU-1 (primary waveform; hippocampal slice cultures and ex vivo whole brains)

target.label: hippocampal CA1 pyramidal neurons in organotypic slice cultures; dorsal surface of ex vivo whole brain

timing.protocol_description: LILFU waveforms used as stimuli were generated by repeating pulse trains of US tone bursts at a pulse repetition frequency until a desired number of tone bursts had been generated. Our primary LILFU waveform (LILFU-1) had the following properties: f = 0.44 MHz, TBD = 22.7 ms, c/tb = 10, PRF = 5 sec sweep 0-100 Hz, and Ntb = 250. A related brief waveform (f = 0.44 MHz, TBD = 0.18 msec, c/tb = 80, PRF = 10 Hz, and Ntb = 3) was also used in some Ca2+ imaging experiments to elicit faster-kinetic transients.

flags.reason: Text states TBD = 22.7 ms for a c/tb = 10 burst at f = 0.44 MHz; 10 cycles at 0.44 MHz corresponds to ~22.7 microseconds, not milliseconds. Likely a unit typo/OCR error in the source (ms vs µs), but recorded verbatim per instructions rather than corrected.

LILFU-1 uses a linearly swept PRF (0 to 100 Hz over 5 s), not a fixed PRF value, so it cannot be represented as a single number; recorded as not_reported and described fully in protocol_description. A related brief waveform used a fixed PRF of 10 Hz (mentioned in protocol_description) but was not modelled as a separate list value.

This exposure aggregates experiments performed in organotypic hippocampal slice cultures and separately in ex vivo whole mouse brains (imaged from the dorsal surface while LILFU-1 was transmitted from the ventral surface); both used the same LILFU-1 waveform and are combined here rather than split into a third exposure.

Sample sizes are reported per-assay in terms of cells/boutons and slices (e.g., n=24 cells from 6 slices; n=148 release sites from 15 slices) rather than as a single subject count for the study; not reduced to one number.

The schema does not offer a null/not-applicable option for auditory_control (unlike anaesthesia, randomised, blinding); set to ['not_reported'] even though this is in vitro/ex vivo tissue work where auditory confounds are not physiologically applicable.

provenance.notes: This is an in vitro/ex vivo study (organotypic hippocampal slice cultures, ex vivo whole mouse brains, and some whole-cell patch-clamp recordings); anaesthesia, auditory_control, randomised and blinding are set to null as not applicable to tissue/cell work per the schema. The paper also states an aggregate safety figure ('The peak rarefactional pressure used in our studies was <1 MPa') describing the whole set of LILFU waveforms tested, which is not assignable to a single exposure and was not entered as a field value.
